findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_quarterly_update" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_transactions, send_invoice, prepare_quarterly_update · Private data: prepare_business_document, get_tax_position, list_transactions, add_transaction, log_mileage_trip, send_invoice_from_card, mark_invoice_paid, prepare_quarterly_update · Public sink: create_invoice, send_invoice, send_invoice_from_card · Destructive: calculate_salary_sacrifice, generate_invoice_numbers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_transactions, send_invoice, prepare_quarterly_update · Private data: prepare_business_document, get_tax_position, list_transactions, add_transaction, log_mileage_trip, send_invoice_from_card, mark_invoice_paid, prepare_quarterly_update · Public sink: create_invoice, send_invoice, send_invoice_from_card · Destructive: calculate_salary_sacrifice, generate_invoice_numbers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "send_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Email an invoice with its PDF to the client address on it, from the person's business name. This sends a real email to the client." → after: "Get one of the signed-in person’s invoices ready to email, with its PDF, to the client address on it from their business name. It opens a card showing exactly what the client will receive (who it goes to, the lines and the total) with a Send button. Nothing is emailed until the person presses Send o"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
